_about: Answers for Play Console → Policy and programs → App content (محتوى التطبيق). These forms have no API: open store/tools/app_content.html to copy each answer. Update this file and store/privacy_forms.md when the app starts collecting new data or adds ads, sign-in, payments or health features.

sections.title: App access

items.a: All or some functionality in my app is restricted
No account is needed: on the first screen tap "Train on my own", then "Pick a ready plan". To try gym features, tap "I have a code. Type it here" and enter this invite code: <CODE>

notes: Replace <CODE>: create a test gym in the captain dashboard (https://azmm-dash.pages.dev), add a trainee and copy the code. A code works once: make a new one for each review and keep the test gym.

sections.title: Ads

items.a: No, my app does not contain ads

notes: No ad SDK in the app. Check once that the merged manifest has no android.permission.AD_ID.

sections.title: Content rating

items.q: Violence, fear, sexuality, gambling, language, controlled substances, crude humour
items.q_ar: العنف والخوف والجنس والقمار واللغة والمواد الخاضعة للرقابة والفكاهة البذيئة

items.q: Users can interact or exchange content
items.q_ar: يمكن للمستخدمين التفاعل أو تبادل المحتوى

notes: No chat or posts: a captain sees only their own gym's members' training. How-to videos are YouTube videos the app or the gym picked, not a browser. Expected rating: Everyone / PEGI 3 / IARC 3+.

sections.title: Target audience
notes: Owner's choice: 13–17 can be added later; under 13 brings Google's Families policy.

notes: Full reasoning: store/privacy_forms.md → Google Play: Data safety.
Name, user IDs: gym members. Email and fitness info: gym members, and solo members who turn backup on.

Before submitting: PostHog → Project settings → Discard client IP data, and Sentry → Security & Privacy → Prevent storing of IP addresses. If either stays off, also declare Location → Approximate location (Analytics).
Not collected: location, contacts, photos and videos (the camera image never leaves the phone), audio, files, messages, financial info, web history, installed apps.
